profile_text.body:
Descript is a for-profit startup founded in 2017 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. The company describes itself as an AI video and audio editor that makes editing as easy as editing text: users record or upload footage, Descript's AI transcribes it, and edits to the transcript are reflected directly in the video, so deleting a word removes that moment of footage and moving a sentence repositions the corresponding clip. The platform is presented as an all-in-one tool covering recording, transcription, editing, and publishing.

The company offers two tracked AI products. The first is the core Descript editor, which sits in the video generation and editing category and includes a feature called Underlord, described on the site as an AI co-editor that can turn a raw recording into a finished cut and handle tasks on the user's behalf. The second is Descript Overdub, a voice cloning tool in the voice and audio category that the site indicates requires consent recording and that the held facts flag for deepfake risk and media integrity considerations.

The held facts show no litigation on record for Descript, but the site does carry a notable California legal exposure count of 161, suggesting significant regulatory or compliance surface area under California law.
